Bodegas y Viñedos Aalto

Aalto

RedDesignation of Origin (DO) Ribera del Duero

The main red of Bodegas Aalto, made from Tinto Fino from numerous old plots in different villages of Ribera del Duero and aged in oak.

Aalto is the red that gives its name to the winery founded in 1999 by Mariano García and Javier Zaccagnini. Its approach is to bring together grapes from old Tinto Fino vineyards spread across different villages of Ribera del Duero, in the provinces of Burgos and Valladolid, to create a wine that reflects the region’s diversity.

The plots, with different soils and altitudes, are harvested and vinified separately. Once aged in barrel, the different lots are blended to achieve the balance sought in each vintage. Ageing takes place in oak barrels, mainly French, for an extended period, followed by bottle rest.

The result is a concentrated, structured red with the ripe fruit and depth of colour typical of Ribera, firm tannins and the ability to develop for years. It is one of the best-known wines of the new generation of Ribera that emerged at the end of the twentieth century.

Tasting profile

Intense deep cherry red. Aromas of ripe black fruit, liquorice, spice and toasty oak. Fleshy and structured on the palate, with firm tannins and a persistent finish.

Food pairing

Chargrilled red meat, roast milk-fed lamb, large game, aged sheep’s cheeses

Serving

16-18 °C, decanted, large glass
